final:
-- Picks an element of a non-empty list from an integer seed.
-- Deterministic: the same seed always selects the same index.

pick_index(n: int, seed: int) -> int =
  pre n > 0
  post out >= 0 and out < n
  ex pick_index(3, 7) == 1
  ex pick_index(3, 7) == pick_index(3, 7)
  seed % n

pick(xs: List[int], seed: int) -> int =
  pre xs.len() > 0
  post out == xs[seed % xs.len()]
  ex pick([10, 20, 30], 7) == 20
  ex pick([5], -4) == 5
  xs[pick_index(n: xs.len(), seed: seed)]

test_pick() =
  assert pick([10, 20, 30], 7) == 20
  assert pick([5], -4) == 5
  assert pick([10, 20, 30], 7) == pick([10, 20, 30], 7)
